response.sql: WITH per_race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) as avg_points_per_race, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins_per_race FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points_per_race) as avg_points, AVG(avg_wins_per_race) as avg_wins FROM per_race_averages GROUP BY country), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as global_avg_wins FROM country_averages) SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_points, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - gm.global_avg_wins as avg_wins_minus_global_mean FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN global_mean gm ORDER BY ca.country
